sampling_query: active public self-hosted monitoring dashboard; previously unseen benchmark repository
frozen_evidence_boundary: repository metadata and pinned git ref
pinned-source code search used only to locate proxy save/apply paths
no issue, PR, discussion, release-history, support or complaint evidence opened before Phase B/C freeze
raw_signal_observation: The proxy settings UI exposes an enabled/active switch and submits proxy.active, but Proxy.save persists bean.active = proxy.active || true. A deliberate false therefore collapses to true on the save path.
material_claim: The repository establishes a deterministic local value-domain defect: saving an inactive proxy through this path cannot preserve false. This is a narrow reversible code correction that can be resolved at REPO authority with a regression fixture; no field claim is needed.
neta_next_move: Add a regression test that saves a proxy with active=false and asserts false is persisted, then replace truthy defaulting with a default that preserves explicit false.
reversal_condition: Reverse only if an explicit product contract establishes that persisted proxies must always be active and the UI switch has a different documented meaning; otherwise preserve false exactly.
baseline_decision: BUILD: fix bean.active = proxy.active || true so the disabled state can persist, and add a regression test.

evidence: Issue #5477 independently establishes a real user need to bypass/disable proxy use in some monitoring configurations, but it concerns environment-proxy selection rather than the proxy.active persistence mechanism under adjudication.
Post-freeze searches found no admissible issue or merged PR reproducing the exact false-to-true coercion in Proxy.save at the pinned SHA.
The frozen source itself remains deterministic about the local mechanism: JavaScript truthy defaulting converts false to true before persistence.
adjudication.decision_delta: NO_MATERIAL_DIFFERENCE: both Neta and baseline authorized the same narrow repository fix; external evidence did not add a baseline-vs-Neta advantage.
adjudication.lesson: An explicit boolean false erased by truthy defaulting is a repository-resolvable local defect; independent neighboring proxy complaints must not be laundered into confirmation of that exact mechanism.
